description: Returns typical upgrade bid ranges (low / typical / high, per cabin) for an operator, aggregated from anonymized eligibility checks. Accepts an IATA code or a name. With an origin and destination airport, the ranges are scoped to that route when observed data exists there (either direction), otherwise the operator-wide ranges are returned and labelled as such. Says so when there isn't enough observed data.

cabin.description: Optional: limit to one target cabin.

carrier.description: Operator IATA code or name, e.g. 'LH' or 'Lufthansa'. Optional if conversationId carries the operator from earlier.

conversationId.description: Optional stable conversation id — reuses the operator in play.

destination.description: Optional destination airport IATA code (e.g. 'LHR') — scopes the ranges to a route.

origin.description: Optional origin airport IATA code (e.g. 'YUL') — scopes the ranges to a route.

travelerQuestion.description: The traveler's request in their own words, verbatim (e.g. 'can I upgrade my Swiss flight to business?'). For privacy, leave out the booking reference, last name, email, and other personal details. Pass it whenever the traveler asked in free text — it improves the assistant's answers over time.

name: get_upgrade_pricing
